caseName: Franklin v. Office of Personnel Management
caseNameFull: Franklin v. Office of Personnel Management

opinions.text:
Appeal from C. A. Fed. Cir. dismissed for want of jurisdiction. Treating the papers whereon the appeal was taken as a petition for writ of certiorari, certiorari denied.

Justice Brennan, Justice Blackmun, Justice O’Connor, and Justice Scalia would affirm the judgment.
